body.p: The following listing of claims will replace all prior versions and listings of claims in the application.

br.br:
1. (currently amended) A vehicle control system comprising:
a vehicle control device configured to control traveling of an autonomous driving vehicle; and
a center device configured to communicate with the vehicle control device, wherein the center device includes at least one processor and a memory coupled to the at least one processor, configured to recognize that the autonomous driving vehicle terminates autonomous driving,(i) set, when the at least one processor of the center device processor recognizes that the autonomous driving vehicle terminates the autonomous driving, a first stop position for stopping the autonomous driving vehicle as a target vehicle based on position information transmitted from the target vehicle autonomous driving vehicle that indicates the autonomous driving vehicle to terminate the autonomous driving and map information previously prepared and (ii) transmit the first stop position to the target vehicle autonomous driving vehicle,
acquire a type of a passenger of the target vehicle autonomous driving vehicle, and
set a relief method measure method for the passenger according to the type of the passenger and set a dialogue method for dialogue with the passenger according to the type of the passenger,
the vehicle control device includes at least one processor and a memory coupled to the at least one processor, configured to recognize a fault of an in-vehicle device used for autonomous driving in the autonomous driving vehicle or a temporarily unusable state of the in-vehicle device by monitoring an operation state of a signal transmitted from the in-vehicle device,receive inappropriate information indicating that the autonomous driving is inappropriate for the autonomous driving vehicle the fault of the in-vehicle device or the temporarily unusable state of the in-vehicle device,
set a second stop position for stopping the autonomous driving vehicle as the target vehicle,
transmit at least the position information of the target vehicle autonomous driving vehicle to the center device and acquire the first stop position, and
cause the target vehicle autonomous driving vehicle to head to the second stop position, which has been decided by the vehicle control device placed on the target vehicle autonomous driving vehicle, in a case where the first stop position is not acquired from the center device, and cause the target vehicle autonomous driving vehicle to head to the first stop position in a case where the first stop position is acquired from the center device,
the center device is placed outside the autonomous driving vehicle and the vehicle control device is placed [[to]]on the autonomous driving vehicle, and the center device and the vehicle control device wirelessly communicate with each other,
the type of the passenger of the target vehicle includes types of a passenger classified based on a degree of assistance required for a relief to the passenger, and
the first stop position is decided by the center device and the second stop position is decided by the vehicle control device.
2. (currently amended) The vehicle control system according to claim 1, wherein the at least one processor of the center device processor outputs an instruction to a relief vehicle to head to the first stop position, and
the first stop position, which is set by the at least one processor of the center device processor, is a position intermediate between a present position of the relief vehicle and a present position of the target autonomous driving vehicle.
3. (currently amended) The vehicle control system according to claim 2, wherein the at least one processor of the center device processor sets the first stop position at a position temporally intermediate between a present position of the relief vehicle and a present position of the target autonomous driving vehicle.
4. (currently amended) The vehicle control system according to claim 1, wherein when the type of the passenger includes a person requiring care, the at least one processor of the center device processor sets the first stop position at a predetermined position having space necessary for the required care.
